description.value: Folke is an exclusively plant-based fine dining restaurant on Vancouver's West Broadway, serving shared plates and chef's tasting menus built around British Columbia's seasonal farms, forests, and coastline. Recognized in the MICHELIN Guide 2025 and named among Canada's Best New Restaurants 2023, it crafts everything in-house—from breads and ferments to desserts—and operates as a no-tipping establishment. Weekend brunch, complete with a pastry and cake table offering take-home boxes, makes it a distinctive stop for cyclists passing through Kitsilano.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, and email all match). The About and Menus pages confirm Folke is an exclusively plant-based restaurant—OSM tag diet:vegan=only aligns with the website's statement 'everything on the menu is vegan,' and the Reservations page confirms gluten-free and nut-free options are available. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refills, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities was found in either the website content or OSM tags, and OSM opening hours appear outdated relative to the current website schedule.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Th-Su 17:00-22:30; Mo 17:00-21:00) appears outdated: website shows Thursday-Sunday brunch and dinner service with no Monday hours listed, suggesting the schedule has changed since the OSM record was last updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Folke is a well-established, award-recognized restaurant on a key Kitsilano cycling corridor; its all-vegan menu, weekend brunch with take-home pastry boxes, and MICHELIN recognition make it a distinctive and useful listing for touring cyclists.
